download.title: Someone shared a file with you
download.success: Saved. You will find the file in your downloads.
download.subtitle: The file is unlocked here on your device
download.passwordHint: The link you were sent usually fills this in. Paste it if the sender sent it separately.
download.senderPasswordHint: The sender locked this file with a password. It is not part of the link, so ask them for it.

shell.tagline: Encrypted before it leaves your device

browser.title: BROWSER ERROR
browser.message: Your browser doesn't support required operations. Please try a different browser.

server.file_not_found: File not found. The link may have expired or the file was deleted.
server.download_count_expired: This file has reached its download limit.
server.file_not_yet_downloadable: This file is not available yet. Please try again later.
server.download_location_forbidden: Downloads are not allowed from your location.
server.file_not_found_or_limit_exceeded: File not found, or its download limit has been reached.
server.file_retrieval_failed: The file could not be retrieved. Please try again.
server.rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
server.invalid_file_id: This download link is not valid.
server.tls_requirements_not_met: Your connection does not meet the required security level.
server.user_agent_blocked: The browser used for the download is not allowed here.

upload.regionHint: Only people in these countries can open the link
upload.regionAligned: EU / EEA and countries with the same rules
upload.delayHint: How long before the link starts working
upload.emailHint: One email each time someone opens the link
upload.passwordHint: A second lock on top of the link. Pass it on another way; it cannot be recovered.
upload.stripHint: Location, camera and author details are taken out first. Pictures other than GIFs are re-encoded, other file types are refused.
upload.ephemeralHint: How long the picture stays on screen
upload.submitHint: Anyone who has the link can open the file, so pass it on carefully.
upload.tooBig: The file is too big. The most this server takes is {{size}} MiB.
upload.stripFailed: Could not remove the hidden data: {{message}}
upload.notStrippable: Hidden data cannot be removed from {{type}}, so it cannot be sent as a picture. Send it as a file instead.

files.title: Your uploads
files.recordFailed: Could not read the download record: {{message}}
files.recordGone: This share is gone from the server, and its record with it.
files.reasonLocation: the country it came from is not allowed
files.reasonTooEarly: the delay had not passed yet
files.reasonBrowser: the browser is not allowed here
files.reasonSpent: the share had no downloads left
files.reasonMissing: the file was no longer on the server
files.prolongEmpty: Pick days or downloads to add

uploaded.title: Uploaded
uploaded.linkHint: The password is built into the link, so send it exactly as it is.
uploaded.passwordNotice: Send the link as it is, and the password another way. Neither one opens the file alone.
uploaded.note: Anyone who gets this link can open the file, so send it somewhere only the recipient can read.

footer.keptFile: Uploaded file and file name, encrypted: processed so the recipient can download them. Erased after {{days}} days at the latest, or once the download limit is reached (storage limitation, Art. 5 (1) e).
footer.keptPassword: Decryption password: not processed. It stays in the link and never reaches this server, so the stored copy cannot be read here (encryption, Art. 32 (1) a).
footer.keptEmail: Notification address, optional: processed to inform the sender of download attempts on their own share.
footer.keptClient: IP address, user agent and TLS details of each download attempt: processed so the sender can demonstrate that the transfer was encrypted, where it went, and what was refused (accountability, Art. 5 (2), Art. 24 (1)).
footer.keptClientNone: IP addresses, user agents and TLS details of download attempts: not processed on this server.
footer.keptLocation: City, region and country of the downloading IP address: determined against a database on this server, without involving a third party.
footer.keptReport: Web address of a download link that did not open, with the IP address and user agent of the visitor: processed to find faults on this server. Erased after {{days}} days at the latest.
footer.operator: Controller, and any processing beyond this: the operator of this server.
footer.law: Article references are to the GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679).
